strings.Czy mogę jeszcze złożyć papierowy wniose: Can I still file a paper residence-card application?
strings.Nie. Od 27 kwietnia 2026 r. wnioski o ze: No. From 27 April 2026, applications for temporary residence, permanent residence and EU long-term resident status are filed exclusively online via the MOS system. A paper application will be left unexamined. There are exceptions (e.g. certain family matters and ICT) — we'll check whether they apply to your situation.
strings.Nie znam polskiego. Jak wypełnię wniosek: I don't speak Polish. How do I complete the MOS application?
strings.Formularz MOS dostępny jest wyłącznie po: The MOS form is available in Polish only. That's exactly why we offer the "Error-free application" package — we complete and file the application together with you, speaking in your language (English, Spanish, Portuguese).
strings.Czy mogę legalnie przebywać w Polsce w t: Can I stay in Poland legally while my application is being processed?
strings.Co do zasady tak — po skutecznym złożeni: As a rule, yes — once the application is effectively filed, you receive a certificate that legalises your stay until the decision. The condition is filing on time, during a legal stay. Every situation requires individual assessment.
strings.W pakietach z reprezentacją zobowiązujem: In packages with representation we undertake to refund our fee if you do not obtain a residence card. The detailed terms, including exclusions (e.g. providing false information), are set out in the Terms and Conditions available on the website.
strings.Ile trwa uzyskanie karty pobytu?: How long does it take to obtain a residence card?
strings.Terminy różnią się w zależności od urzęd: Timeframes vary depending on the voivodeship office and the type of case — from several months upwards. A correctly filed application with no formal shortcomings is the most effective way to shorten the wait.
strings.Bezpłatne narzędzia i interaktywne mater: Free tools and interactive materials that explain the path to a residence card in a simple way and help you avoid the most common pitfalls. They do not replace legal advice — they are for learning.
